**Chinese name:** 豪威科技（韦尔股份） (Háowēi Kējì (Wéi'ěr Gǔfèn))

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
OmniVision Technologies (originally a US company) was acquired by a Chinese consortium led by Will Semiconductor in 2019; now operates as OmniVision Group, headquartered in Shanghai, and pursued a Hong Kong IPO — a notable case of a Chinese fabless firm acquiring a once-independent Western chip brand outright rather than building one from scratch.
:::

## What does this firm design?

CMOS image sensors (smartphone and automotive cameras), plus analog and display driver solutions.
